description: FIND-201 (iteration-3) is only PARTIALLY resolved. REQ-CLOUD-EARN contradicts REQ-CLOUD-SAME-BODY's own row ④ exactly as REQ-PORTABILITY used to, just one requirement over. The fix that resolved REQ-PORTABILITY's half of FIND-201 was not applied to REQ-CLOUD-EARN's half.
